advisories: react-router@7.18.2 SSR loader sanitization and SSG build contract constraint
accepted_risks.reason: Upgrading react-router beyond 7.18.2 breaks vite-react-ssg static site generation contract during build prerendering.
accepted_risks.risk_assessment: Low operational risk in production. React Router SSR loader routing is isolated inside authenticated Edge Functions (Supabase Functions & Cloudflare Workers) protected by HMAC session verification. Unauthenticated public routes execute static pre-rendered SSG pages with zero dynamic server-action parameter reflection.

advisories: esbuild development dependency cross-platform optional binary advisory
accepted_risks.reason: esbuild optional native platform binary matrix required for cross-platform build workers (Linux/Cloudflare Pages v3 build image & local dev).
accepted_risks.risk_assessment: Zero runtime risk. esbuild is strictly a build-time development dependency used only during Vite compilation. No esbuild code or binaries are bundled into or executed within production client/worker runtime bundles.
